title: NVIDIA GTC 2026 Keynote
summary: Official replay page for Jensen Huang's GTC keynote covering AI factories, open models, agentic systems, physical AI, and robotics.
notes: S-tier primary source; use as anchor for June 2026 Computex/GTC Taipei catalyst cluster.

title: NVIDIA, Foxconn and Taiwan Medical Centers Bring Agentic and Physical AI to Healthy Taiwan
summary: NVIDIA and Foxconn announced agentic and physical AI deployments across Taiwan medical centers, including CoDoctor agents and Nurabot robotics under a $1.5B Healthy Taiwan initiative.
notes: Tier 2 customer/sovereign-AI confirmation. Supply-chain overlay: Foxconn as integrator, edge/robotics compute and hospital AI infrastructure demand; confirmation attempt through Foxconn Computex platform release.

title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ramps Into Full Production to Power Agentic AI Factories Worldwide
summary: NVIDIA said Vera Rubin is ramping into full production as a POD-scale AI-factory platform spanning Vera Rubin NVL72, Vera CPU, BlueField-4 STX storage and Spectrum-6 SPX Ethernet racks.
notes: Tier 1 demand/capacity signal. Supply-chain overlay: upstream HBM/advanced packaging and TSMC ecosystem, midstream OEM/ODM partners, downstream AI clouds and enterprises, with power/cooling via liquid-cooled MGX and 800 VDC references. Confirmation attempts: Foxconn Computex release, Supermicro Vera Rubin IR release, and TrendForce HBM4 validation coverage.

title: NVIDIA Unveils Vera, the CPU for Agents
summary: NVIDIA announced Vera as a CPU for AI-agent workloads, with customers including NYSE, Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, ByteDance, CoreWeave and OCI and systems from major OEMs/ODMs.
notes: Tier 1 product/customer signal. Supply-chain overlay: demand confirmed by labs/clouds, manufacturing confirmed by Dell/HPE/Lenovo/Supermicro and Taiwan ODM list; upstream memory/package capacity remains the gating risk.

title: NVIDIA Launches Cosmos 3, the Open Frontier Foundation Model for Physical AI
summary: NVIDIA launched Cosmos 3 open physical-AI foundation models for robotics, autonomous vehicles and vision AI, plus a Cosmos Coalition with model and robotics partners.
notes: Tier 1 physical-AI platform signal. Supply-chain overlay: downstream robotics/AV/vision demand; confirmation attempt through NVIDIA GTC Taipei physical-AI releases and DRIVE/GR00T items in the same official source cluster.

title: NVIDIA Launches Alpamayo 2 Super Open Reasoning Model for Robotaxis
summary: NVIDIA introduced Alpamayo 2 Super, AlpaGym and OmniDreams for reasoning-based level 4 autonomous-vehicle development and closed-loop simulation.
notes: Tier 1 AV/physical-AI product signal. Supply-chain overlay: downstream AV developers and simulation workloads; confirmation attempt through DRIVE Hyperion ecosystem release.

title: NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion Becomes the Global Platform for a Robotaxi-Ready World
summary: NVIDIA expanded DRIVE Hyperion level 4 robotaxi ecosystem with Foxconn, VinFast/Autobrains, Uber and HUMAIN deployments across Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Europe and the Middle East.
notes: Tier 2 customer/platform confirmation. Supply-chain overlay: in-vehicle compute, sensors, EV manufacturing and mobility-network demand; confirmation attempt through Foxconn Computex and Healthy Taiwan physical-AI partner releases.

title: NVIDIA DGX Station for Windows Puts a Trillion-Parameter AI Supercomputer on Every Enterprise Desk
summary: NVIDIA announced DGX Station for Windows, built on the GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip, to bring frontier AI-agent infrastructure into Windows enterprise workflows.
notes: Tier 1 product/customer signal. Supply-chain overlay: GB300 desktop superchip demand, Windows enterprise channel, high-memory workstation component needs; confirmation attempt via official Microsoft/RTX Spark cluster and Computex trade coverage.

title: NVIDIA Announces NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot for Academic Research
summary: NVIDIA announced an open humanoid robot reference design using Jetson Thor, Isaac GR00T software and a Unitree H2 Plus platform for research institutions.
notes: Tier 1 physical-AI product signal. Supply-chain overlay: edge compute and robot component demand, downstream research/developer adoption; confirmation attempt through Cosmos 3 and Foxconn healthcare/robotics official items.

title: Enterprise Software Leaders Build AI Agents With NVIDIA
summary: NVIDIA announced Agent Toolkit/NemoClaw, Nemotron 3 Ultra, OpenShell and CUDA-X agent skills with adoption by design, simulation, cybersecurity and enterprise-software partners.
notes: Tier 2 downstream software/customer confirmation. Supply-chain overlay: strengthens enterprise agent demand rather than hardware capacity; confirmation attempt through named CAD/security/software partners and DGX/RTX local-agent hardware cluster.

title: NVIDIA GTC Taipei at COMPUTEX Live Updates on What Is Next in AI
summary: NVIDIA's GTC Taipei live blog highlighted Vera Rubin full production, 800 VDC/MGX power architecture, liquid-cooled rack design, Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics production, Taiwan supply-chain scale, and Jensen's H2 2026 roadmap hint around Grace Blackwell, Vera Rubin and an undisclosed surprise product.
notes: Mandatory supply-chain overlay source. Confirms upstream-to-downstream AI factory stack, 150 Taiwan partners, 350+ factories and 30 countries, plus power/cooling constraints via MGX/800 VDC/liquid cooling. Also records Jensen quote that H2 2026 will be busy with Grace Blackwell, Vera Rubin and an undisclosed surprise product; Chinese/Taiwan reports confirm the capacity-expansion context around Quanta/QCT and TSMC.

title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Reinvent Windows PCs for the Age of Personal AI
summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced RTX Spark Windows PCs for personal AI agents, with Jensen Huang framing RTX Spark as the new personal AI computer.
notes: Primary-source product/customer signal; market read is NVDA AI-PC narrative plus Windows/OEM ecosystem attention.

title: NVIDIA DSX Gives Infrastructure Builders the Playbook for AI Factories
summary: NVIDIA announced DSX as a design, simulation and operations platform for AI factories, tying compute, networking, energy, power and cooling signals into infrastructure workflows.
notes: Tier 1 AI-factory infrastructure/supply-chain signal. Supply-chain overlay: downstream cloud partners CoreWeave/Crusoe/Firmus/IREN/Lambda/Nebius/Nscale/Yotta; midstream Dell/HPE/Lenovo/Supermicro and Taiwan ODMs; facilities/power/cooling via DSX OS, DSX Sim, DSX Flex and DSX Exchange. Confirmation attempt: NVIDIA DSX product page and GTC Taipei MGX/800 VDC live-blog section.
